analysis: The observation of multiple nodules in the lungs on chest x-ray suggests consideration of pulmonary metastases. Suspected nosocomial pneumonia can be inferred from the presence of a new infiltrate on the chest x-ray. However, the presence of multiple nodules is more indicative of metastases than a single infiltrate. Colonic anastomosis dehiscence would typically present with specific findings related to the surgical site rather than on a chest x-ray. PET scan abnormal uptake would not be directly visible on a chest x-ray. Given the information provided, the most likely correct option is that the patient has pulmonary metastases.
